title: Mission 1 — Arrival in Rīga
summary: You land at Rīga Airport and need to get to your apartment in Vecrīga. Practice greetings, asking directions, and paying for a taxi.
summary_lv: Tu ierodies Rīgas lidostā un dodies uz dzīvokli Vecrīgā. Vingrinies sasveicināšanā, ceļa jautāšanā un norēķinā ar taksometru.

scenes.title: Greet the taxi driver
scenes.instruction: Greet the taxi driver Māris and ask if he can take you to Vecrīga.
scenes.instruction_lv: Sasveicinies ar Māri un pajautā, vai viņš tevi var aizvest uz Vecrīgu.
target_phrases: Vai jūs varat aizvest mani uz Vecrīgu?

scenes.title: Ask about the fare
scenes.instruction: Ask Māris how much the ride will cost.

scenes.title: Pay and thank the driver
scenes.instruction: Pay for the ride, thank the driver, and say goodbye politely.
scenes.instruction_lv: Norēķinies, pasaki paldies un atvadies pieklājīgi.
